thread:
sara: Heads up — saw a big spend spike for Nimbus on hosted this morning, flagged by the weekly budget monitor. :eyes:

sara: Quick numbers: week-to-date hosted spend = $18.4k, committed monthly = $8k, projected end-of-month burn if trend continues ~ $72k. Pulled from the console: https://console.redwood.ai/customers/nimbus/usage

matt: Yikes. Any idea if this is traffic growth or a client bug?

omar: Running a quick query against request logs to split by route and avg tokens per request. Will paste results in a sec.

omar: ```sql
SELECT route, count(*) as calls, avg(tokens_used) as avg_tokens
FROM hosted_api_requests
WHERE customer_id='nimbus' AND ts > now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY route
ORDER BY calls DESC;
```

omar: Preliminary: two routes account for 78% of tokens — /generate-long and /embed-bulk. avg_tokens for /generate-long jumped from ~420 to ~3,200 last 48h.

lisa: I saw an inbound client bug last night where they accidentally switched from stream->full mode and a retry loop amplified payloads. They pushed a patch earlier but it might have been running for ~20h.

jia: From infra: latency and 5xx rates look steady for Nimbus — no runtime errors that would explain repeats. So this aligns with increased tokens per request rather than failed retries.

billing-bot: Billing alert created: nimbus - hosted_spend > commit threshold (alert id: BA-2026-1123).

sara: Ok action plan: 1) contact customer to confirm client-side issue and confirm patch rollout 2) if confirmed, offer transient throttle / temporary quota to stop burn 3) create invoice hold/adjustment if necessary and flag renewals.

matt: I'll ping their CSM and set up a sync for today 2pm PT. Sara can you draft a short note with the numbers + recommended temporary quota? I can join the call.

sara: Drafting now. Proposed temporary quota: cap requests to median 95th percentile of last 30 days (approx 25 req/min) and block bulk embed calls until they confirm fix.

lisa: We can flip a customer-level rate limit on hosted API via the console. CLI snippet: `rwctl customer rate-limit set --id nimbus --rps 0.4 --burst 10` (will momentarily throttle, will push an audit event).

omar: Also recommend we add a short-term model fallback to smaller variant for /embed-bulk to reduce token cost while they stabilize. I'll open an infra task.

jia: I'll keep an eye on billing pipeline metrics and mark the account as "at-risk" in the dashboard so renewals sees it.

billing-bot: Billing action: hold_created by sara for nimbus (hold id: H-9982).

sara: Copy. I'll send the customer note and schedule the call. Follow-ups: matt (CSM) lead call, lisa apply rate-limit, omar open infra task for fallback, jia update dashboard, billing to prepare potential pro-rated adjustment.

matt: :thumbsup: thanks everyone. Will report back after 2pm sync.

sara: Filed a follow-up thread in the customer record and linked the alert. Leaving this thread open for updates — pls add short replies only.

matt: Update 14:10 PT — spoke with Nimbus engineering. They confirmed the retry loop. Patch deployed at 13:45 PT. We agreed to the temporary quota; they requested a one-time credit for the excess spend while the bug was active.

billing-bot: Credit request ticket created: CR-452 (owner: finance).

omar: Post-patch stats show avg_tokens for /generate-long back down to ~460, and week-projected burn reduced to ~$22k. Still above commit but manageable.

sara: Great. I'll coordinate the credit discussion with finance and keep renewals informed. Resolving alert tentatively — will re-open if burn creeps up again. :white_check_mark:
